src/inference_portal/inference_portal/main.py

Python · Tier A

Start the standalone Inference Portal from command-line and environment options.

Details

parser defines listener and state-directory choices; main creates the API and runs Uvicorn, closing the portal store when the server exits. Restart handling uses the packaged runtime context when present. Controller-integrated inference uses its own application lifecycle instead of this standalone entry point.

@see src/inference_portal/inference_portal/api.py

@see src/controller_inference/integration.py

Symbol Line Documentation

main 43 Construct the portal and run Uvicorn, or close the store after the import-only check. Service requests set Uvicorn's exit flag; restart returns status 75 for managed/packaged launchers or replaces the direct Python process with the same CLI.

src/inference_portal/inference_portal/cancellation_transport.py

Python · Tier A

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

Budget 41 Track shared HTTP, inference-request and received-byte limits across one cancellation campaign. Bounded reads and stream readers consume this budget so polling and diagnostic inference cannot silently exceed campaign limits.
Budget.dispatch 48 Reserve one HTTP call and optionally one inference call before dispatch; raise DiagnosticFailure when either applicable request limit is exhausted.
Budget.received 55 Charge received bytes to the campaign and fail once the aggregate byte limit is exceeded.
Budget.read 63 Read one successful, nonredirecting GET within the stage deadline and per-response/campaign byte limits. Endpoint rejection or exhausted limits raise DiagnosticFailure; the response context closes on every exit.

OwnedRequest.start 95 Start the owned stream reader using the supplied task owner and return the request handle for later observation and cleanup.
OwnedRequest._read 102 Send one bounded streaming chat request and parse SSE data into observation state. Track dispatch/header/progress timing, retain safe failure codes and close only this response in finally; cancellation propagates and unconfirmed close remains an error.
OwnedRequest.observe 159 Validate one streamed response chunk and accumulate bounded usage and a single indexed tool call. Reject provider errors, unsupported choice/call shapes and oversized fields; record recognized terminal reasons without treating partial output as success.
OwnedRequest.close 214 Idempotently cancel and await this request's reader within the stage timeout. Record close timestamps only after response closure is confirmed; raise if cleanup remains pending and never close the shared HTTP client or worker.

payload 286 Construct the synthetic streaming chat payload for a campaign role and phase. The cancellable request emits long text, optionally with a repeated prefill prefix; survivor/replacement requests receive the fixed tool schema for correctness checks.

Details

Neither function starts a model: the supervisor owns process launch. Keeping command construction separate makes effective launch settings inspectable.

Start the installed Portal service or a separate foreground checkout.

Usage

No arguments starts inference-portal.service; --dev forwards Portal options; --help performs no installation.

Inputs

systemd and optional sudo for installed mode; --dev requires the adjacent .venv and uses PORTAL_STATE_DIR or adjacent .state.

Side effects

Installed mode starts a stopped service using saved settings. Development mode sets PYTHONPATH and execs the local Portal module.

Cleanup

An installed service remains managed by systemd; development mode transfers process lifetime to Python without updating installed code.
